text:
support: Acme (acct: acme-prod) opened ticket: huge tail-latency regression on /v1/generate (model: redwood-7b-v2). p95 jumped ~260ms -> ~620ms, p99 ~2.4s. sample req id req_20260315_03_31_9123
maria: tagging infra oncall @alex @jia — any deploys or model swaps around 03:20-03:35Z?
alex: SLOs are p95 < 300ms, p99 < 800ms. those are being breached. checking deploy history now.
deploy-bot: rollout: inference-runtime-service v2.14.1 -> v2.15.0 canary started 2026-03-15T03:22:11Z
deploy-bot: rollout: model redwood-7b-v2 -> redwood-7b-v2-quantized-optim (canary) 2026-03-15T03:25:04Z
jia: metrics show latency spike correlating with model canary traffic at ~03:25.
ryan: triage plan: isolate whether this is model-variant vs runtime change; immediate mitigations: fallback model, circuit breaker, rollback if necessary.
maria: priority now — enable fallback to stable model and add per-org circuit breaker. alex can you flip the route?
alex: running rdwctl to set fallback:
```
rdwctl routes set --route /v1/generate --project acme-prod --fallback-model redwood-7b-v1 --force
rdwctl routes get --project acme-prod --route /v1/generate
```
sre-oncall-bot: route update accepted (route-update-7782)
support: Acme sees p95 -> ~280ms after fallback; p99 still ~900ms for a handful of requests. partial relief.
jia: gathering pod-level metrics, nvprof traces, and kernel_select logs.
alex: `kubectl get pods -n inference -l svc=inference-runtime -o wide` -> 18 pods; canary subset shows GPU util ~95%.
ryan: high GPU util on canary pods suggests quantized variant might be heavier or using different kernels. options: scale canary, pin traffic away from canary, rollback.
maria: pin non-experimental tenants away from canary, increase internal batcher queue, add circuit breaker to limit in-flight requests per org.
alex: applying circuit breaker + queue tweak now:
```
{
  "route": "/v1/generate",
  "circuit_breaker": {
    "max_inflight_per_org": 40,
    "max_queue_length": 100,
    "failure_threshold_pct": 50
  }
}
```
`rdwctl config apply --project acme-prod --payload @circuit.json`
sre-oncall-bot: circuit config accepted, will take effect in ~15s
support: after CB + fallback p95 steady ~270-310ms, p99 ~650-750ms. customer relieved and asked for RCA + ETA on permanent fix.
jia: pulling runtime logs for kernel selection and cache stats:
`kubectl logs -n inference pod/inference-canary-7 -c runtime --since=10m | grep "kernel_select"`
alex: observed increased KV cache miss rate during canary — quantized variant may change cache key shapes or not share cache. that would increase per-token work and tail latency.
ryan: if cache invalidation is root cause, add a model-onboarding guard to verify cache compatibility before increasing canary traffic.
maria: ops checklist:
- [x] fallback to stable model for impacted tenants
- [x] apply circuit breaker limits
- [ ] rollback quantized canary if logs indicate incompatibility (jia)
- [ ] run offline perf comparisons between redwood-7b-v1 and v2-quantized
- [ ] add automated fallback rule: if p95 > 400ms for >5m, switch to stable model and page
- [ ] postmortem and update model-onboarding CI
support: notified Acme (INC-2026-0315-07). provisional ETA 3-6h for a full fix; they accepted temporary workaround.
alex: rolling back model canary globally as precaution.
deploy-bot: rollback: redwood-7b-v2-quantized-optim -> redwood-7b-v1 completed 2026-03-15T04:05:12Z
jia: post-rollback p99 ~420ms, p95 ~260ms. incident mitigated. monitoring for 2 hours.
ryan: engineering follow-ups:
- add preflight perf smoke tests for quantized variants (p95/p99 + kv-cache hit rate) before canary >0.5%
- implement automated fallback rule: if p95 > 400ms for 5m, route to stable model and page oncall
- tune alert thresholds (page at p95 >= 300ms or p99 >= 800ms) to reduce noise
maria: creating infra tasks and assigning owners (jia, alex, ryan). will author postmortem + playbook update. :thumbsup: 
support: closing loop with customer; incident doc created at /docs/incidents/INC-2026-0315-07.md
sre-oncall-bot: temporary monitoring rule added: redwood-7b-v2 p99 > 800ms -> page oncall
participants: support, maria, alex, jia, ryan, sre-oncall-bot, deploy-bot
